name: image-forge
description: Provider-agnostic image generation from the terminal: OpenAI GPT Image, Gemini, and MCP-backed generators, with a prompting doctrine and a critique loop that verifies the render before the set is produced.

secret_command.title: Secret manager wrapper
secret_command.description: Command prefix that injects provider API keys into the environment, for example 'doppler run --'. Leave empty to use the ambient environment.

default_provider.title: Default provider
default_provider.description: Provider used when none is passed: openai, gemini.

output_dir.title: Default output directory
output_dir.description: Where renders land when no --out path is given.
